title: U.S. Open Tennis Championships 2026: Here’s Where to Buy Match Tickets Online
summary: The tennis tournament begins on Sunday (Aug. 23) in Queens, New York — buy match tickets here.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The 2026 U.S. Open Tennis Championships features the best and brightest players, such as Jannik Sinner, Carlos Alcaraz, Aryna Sabalenka, Coco Gauff, Alex Eala and others, competing to win the 146th edition of the Grand Slam tournament.

Matches start on Sunday (Aug. 23) with qualifiers and then goes until Sunday (Sept. 13) with the men’s final. The U.S. Open takes place at USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in Queens, New York. Check out a complete tournament schedule here .

Shop 2026 U.S. Open Tennis Tickets at Ticketmaster

Meanwhile, the U.S. Open is considered the “fun” Grand Slam because of its laidback atmosphere, cocktail selection (namely the tournament’s signature “Honey Deuce” drink) and a number of celebrity sightings in previous years, including Taylor Swift, HAIM, Bruce Springsteen, Spike Lee, Usher, P!nk, Joe Keery, Bizarrap and others.

In fact, DJ and record producer Zedd is headlining the official U.S. Open Finals Afterparty at Louis Armstrong Stadium on Saturday (Sept. 12).

Want to attend? Tickets to matches first went on sale through Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets — if they’re unable to attend.

However, matches have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find U.S. Open tickets online is through third-party retailers, such as StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for first serve. Prices may also be above or below face value at times.
